# Milestone brief — source-truth-m3

**Title:** Content-addressed corpus-manifest resource
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** source-truth (plans/source-truth/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** next
**Target:** 2026-08-24 -> 2026-08-28

## Parent epic

- source-truth-e3 — Content-addressed corpus manifest
  arxmcp://corpus-manifest resource returning a content-addressed snapshot: registry revisions with checksums, index build versions, license summary, per-notebook operator override flags, and the corpus_version epoch it maps to; checksums re-verify on a clean re-fetch of 3 sample papers, and manifest-invalidation semantics for withdrawn/superseded revisions are defined here (edges only, no takedown workflow). Resources-surface-only, outside the tools/list hash, so it lands even if the W1 window slips.

## Summary

arxmcp://corpus-manifest returns a content-addressed snapshot — registry revisions with checksums, index build versions, license summary, per-notebook operator override flags, and the corpus_version epoch it maps to — with manifest-invalidation semantics for withdrawn/superseded revisions defined as edges only (no takedown workflow). Resources-surface-only, outside the tools/list hash, so it lands even if the W1 window slips.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given a hydrated registry, when arxmcp://corpus-manifest is read, then it resolves to a content-addressed snapshot whose checksums re-verify on a clean re-fetch of 3 sample papers
2. Given a revision marked withdrawn or superseded in the registry, when the manifest regenerates, then the affected snapshot is invalidated per the documented semantics while EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256 stays unchanged

## Depends on

- source-truth-m1 — Revision registry live with license provenance (advisory) [status: planned]
